about: CodeQL findings reviewed and accepted, each for a stated reason (ADR-52). The CodeQL gate fails on any finding not listed here. Add an entry only with a decision record and the owner's approval; match a rule in one file only.

reviewed.reason: Spring's CSRF tokens are replaced, not dropped: OriginCheckFilter refuses state-changing requests from other sites (Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site), the session cookies are SameSite=Strict, and request bodies are JSON only. See ADR-25.
